description: This file defines an Angular component 'NotesListComponent' for displaying, searching, editing, creating, and deleting notes in a note-taking application. It uses several child components such as header, note cards, editor, delete confirmation, and toast notifications. The component interacts with a NotesService for CRUD operations and maintains internal state for UI control.

classes.name: NotesListComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for managing a list of notes, including creation, editing, deletion, and search functionality. It uses reactive programming with RxJS to handle data streams and user interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component by fetching all notes and setting up a combined observable for filtered notes based on the search query.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Updates the search query BehaviorSubject with the new value to trigger filtering.

methods.name: openEditor
methods.description: Opens the note editor; if a note is provided, pre-fills the draft with its data for editing.

methods.name: saveDraft
methods.description: Saves the current note draft, either updating an existing note or creating a new one, and shows a toast notification.

methods.name: askDelete
methods.description: Prepares to delete a note by setting the target note and opening the confirmation dialog.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Deletes the selected note via the notes service and displays a toast notification based on the result.
